text:
sarah: kicked off Goldfinch POC thread — RFI answers + capability matrix needed. customer wants on-prem option, HSM, and 99th pctl latency targets for embeddings. due EOD Friday. can SEs confirm which parts we can address in the initial POC vs later?

josh: @sarah can you paste the RFI PDF? I skimmed the intro but want specifics on data flows. also need to know expected qps for embedding calls.

sarah: uploaded the pack to gdrive: https://drive.redwood/goldfinch/rfi_v2.pdf (see section 3: infra + section 7: compliance). their embed QPS estimate is 120 req/s peak, 30 sustained.

maya: 120 qps embedding peak is large for Dedicated unless we batch aggressively. for initial POC we can run on dedicated NVidia L4s, but recommend batching window and KV cache.

josh: can we give them a cost ballpark for Dedicated vs Hosted? they asked for monthly run-rate with 99th pctl SLOs.

oliver: quick estimates: Hosted (managed) w/ autoscaling + caching: ~$12k/mo for that load assuming 5-token avg and 40M tokens/mo. Dedicated reserved baseline (4x L4 equiv): ~$28k/mo plus ops. these are rough. will formalize in the capability matrix.

sarah: perfect — we need that in the RFI matrix table under "pricing / ops" column. also question on KMS/HSM: they require FIPS-140 HSM option and customer-managed keys. can Redwood Private support that out of the box?

maya: yes for Private we support customer KMS via our KMS integration and HSM-backed key stores in on-prem packaging. note: HSM provisioning is a slide-level add-on and will push timeline by ~3 weeks. add note in the RFI: "HSM available with Private deployment; lead time applies."

josh: security questionnaire Q4: do we persist raw requests? we need to be explicit.

maya: answer: Hosted: logs are configurable; by default we retain request metadata for 30 days and payloads are redacted. Private: customer controls retention. put exact phrasing: `Hosted: request metadata retained 30d; payloads redacted by default. Private: retention and full logging under customer control.`

oliver: also add fallback policy detail — if Dedicated capacity is saturated we can route to a compatible lower-cost model (quantized) in the same region with automatic A/B fallback. they asked about graceful degradation.

sarah: good. @deploy-bot can you drop the sample capability matrix CSV into this thread when ready?

deploy-bot: uploaded file: https://files.redwood/cap-matrix/goldfinch_poc_matrix_v1.csv :thumbsup:

josh: reviewing matrix now. two small asks: 1) include expected latency numbers for embeddings at 5-token and 256-token contexts; 2) clarify support for function/tool-calling in Private deployments (they use toolchain callbacks).

maya: for latency numbers put: `Embeddings (5 tokens): 99th pctl 45ms (Hosted cached), 85ms (Dedicated baseline)` and `Embeddings (256 tokens): 99th pctl 120ms (Hosted cached), 260ms (Dedicated baseline)`. For function calls: Private supports tool-calling via our local agents bridge — document: https://docs.redwood/private-tool-calling.

oliver: I'm adding a short ops runbook bullet to the attachments: onboarding playbook, network peering checklist, KMS/HSM steps, and POC acceptance criteria.

sarah: client also asked about contractual SLAs — can we commit to 99.9% availability on Dedicated for POC?

maya: we can commit to best-effort for POC; SLA requires Dedicated contract and monitoring setup. recommended language: `POC: best-effort uptime with monitoring; SLA available upon Dedicated contract and onboarding.`

josh: final note: include a quick sample curl for embedding with retry headers. they want to test early.

oliver: sample in matrix under "test steps":
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -d '{"model":"r-instruct-emb-1","input":"test string"}' \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: test-123"
```

sarah: thanks team — I'll assemble the RFI response doc from these notes and attach it to the ticket. aiming to send to Goldfinch legal/procurement Thu morning. please flag any blockers now. :pray:

josh: small blocker — need legal to confirm export controls clause for embeddings; pinging @legal.

maya: flagged — I'll add a line to the RFI: `Export controls: standard U.S. export controls apply; for customer-specific regimes we recommend Private deployment.`

oliver: closing checklist: matrix updated, pricing ballpark included, HSM caveat added, latency numbers added, runbook attached. pulling together final PDF.

sarah: awesome — if nothing else I will post final RFI bundle here tomorrow morning. :rocket:
